reviews.comment: Prof Kuan seemed more occupied with grieving against the university than adequately preparing his students, and as a result, gave lots of extra credit that really wouldn't have been necessary if he had focused more on teaching the class. Really nice guy and good teacher, just wish I would have actually learned more.

Prof Kuan cares more about his students than any other teacher I've ever had. He genuinely wants everyone in his class to pass. His lectures were a bit disorganized at times and could be difficult for people that are new to calc. However, he gave countless opportunities for questions and gave a hefty amount of extra credit. A tip: study past exams!
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Caring--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Kuan is nice as a person but he is not a good lecturer. As a first-time calculus student I struggled, he taught the course like you needed the course itself as a prereq. Lectures were not helpful as only an average of 2-3 example problems would be completed per lecture, so your notes would extremely bare.
reviews.ratingTags: Graded by few things--Accessible outside class--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: The absolute goat. Gave us everything we needed to do well on the tests. Math 151 sucks b/c the engineering department doesn't know what they're doing, but Prof Kuan always fights for his students and makes the class 1000x better. Do the webassign and make sure you pay attention to the groupme b/c he gives hints for the test problems on there.

Professor Kuan was an amazing teacher and was always available whenever you had questions whether that be via email, GroupMe or office hours. His expectation on what to expect on tests and quizzes were always clear. He even posted the lectures to Canvas so if you happen to miss class you can still learn by watching his videos.

Professor Kuan is a great lecturer and is very lenient on assignments. He's not there to fail you and will do everything he can to make your math experience easier. The homework prepares you for the test well. Very cool and understanding prof.

This professor did a great job in Math 411. I am not a math major so I took this class for a math minor. He does great lectures and though he'll show some of the complex math ideas, he focuses on tangible examples and intuition to help with understanding. The exams were fair and he worked with students to make sure we were prepared. Great class.

Absolute Chad. Dr. Kuan provided us with several mock exams for each midterm.  He wants his students to succeed. Homeworks are difficult, but nothing you can't knock out with help from office hours. He made tons of Taylor Swift references, and is overall a caring guy.

Professor Kuan is a great person. He responds to emails quickly and often holds office hours. He definitely cares for the success of his students. One problem I had is that he only assigned 4 homework assignments throughout the semester. I felt like I didn't get enough practice from the homeworks. However he makes it up with practice exams.

Professor Kuan is a very understanding professor who is open to making time for his students. That being said, his lectures are really really bad at explaining calculus to be understandable. I ended up learning everything twice by using other professors' notes because I was so confused. Tests are not that bad, but I just relied on practice exams.

Professor Kuan is one pf the best professor I ever had.I love his lectures even though some test might be difficult but he's so accessible to help student and guide them.He's really an AWESOME professor

Caring person, AWFUL professor. He does not give any homework so it is impossible to actually practice and learn. He does not teach concepts whatsoever so you never actually understand what is going on. The only way you are going to understand the material is by using a textbook outside of class. Avoid this professor if you want to actually learn.

he is such a good professor. the class is hard but his lectures are very helpful, along with practice tests. his lectures are a little boring tbh but you get through them. attendance isn't mandatory but is extra credit plus if you skip class there's literally no way you'll understand. i would take him again though, one of the best profs i've had
reviews.ratingTags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: He definitely cares about his students. He is one of the most understanding profs too. His handwriting is hard to understand. The lectures get really boring and you'll end up skipping class. 3 exams, 10 homeworks. It's not too bad if you can cram everything in before the exam. The exams were easy. It was open-note.

Unfortunately Professor Kuan is rude and unforgiving. He runs his class on google drive instead of the mainstream platforms. His textbook he wrote is not good at all. He makes test problems unnecessarily difficult. The curve he gives seems like it would be enough but it is not for the level of complexity of the tests.
reviews.ratingTags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Prof Kuan is a nice and caring guy and he teaches well. This subject starts off easy, but gets pretty tricky. Kuan has a massive curve though- anything above a 70 is an A, or you can take the final for 100% of your grade, so that really helps. There is weekly homework assignments (which usually aren't too bad) and 3 tests which are all open note.

The course is not heavily proof based or incredibly rigorous from a mathematics perspective, so it should be easy to get a good grade even as a non-mathematician. You will learn a lot taking Dr. Kuans course, and he is an incredible mentor. Take Kuan if you love to learn, and want a challenge. He wont fail you if you put forward effort.
I took 411 with him and he was nice. The problem of this course is that there are too many students from outside math department. As a math student I dont think this course difficult at all.

He was not clear about anything; lectures, homework, or exams. Homework were extremely difficult and some of them were impossible to solve. Also, lecture notes didn't help with the homework at all. Exams were ridiculously difficult. He curves, but if you wanted to learn don't take him. WOSRT Professor I've ever had.

Kuan is a nice guy, but ineffectual as a professor. His lectures hardly covered examples to help you understand difficult concepts. I gave up on his office hours - they just weren't helpful. Homework wasn't like the lecture and the class average on the second test was a 42. I don't feel like I learned anything honestly.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough Grader--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--GRADED BY FEW THINGS
